entities.name: Alexander Görlach
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexander Görlach is a German academic, author and columnist. He currently serves as visiting scholar at the philosophy department of New York University and adjunct professor to NYU Gallatin School where he teaches democratic theory. Prior to that he was a senior fellow at the Carnegie Council for Ethics in International Affairs and a visiting scholar at Harvard University.
